rules.name: combined-var-verify
rules.sql: SELECT current_database() AS db_name, inet_server_port() AS port, current_user AS db_user, now() AS db_time

SELECT business_unit, created_by, count(*) AS row_count, min(value_date) AS min_value_date, max(value_date) AS max_value_date FROM opera.helper_var_accounting_report GROUP BY business_unit, created_by ORDER BY business_unit, created_by

SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM opera.helper_var_accounting_report WHERE UPPER(business_unit) = 'CFS') AS cfs_rows, (SELECT count(*) FROM opera.helper_var_accounting_report WHERE UPPER(business_unit) = 'USG') AS usg_rows, (SELECT count(*) FROM opera.helper_var_accounting_report WHERE UPPER(business_unit) = 'RMC') AS rmc_rows, (SELECT count(*) FROM opera.helper_var_mult_factor_view) AS mult_rows, (SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT a.invenio_product_code, a.value_date FROM opera.helper_var_accounting_report a WHERE a.business_unit IN ('CFS', 'USG', 'RMC') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM opera.helper_var_mult_factor_view m WHERE m.invenio_product_code = a.invenio_product_code AND m.value_date = a.value_date)) x) AS accounting_pairs_without_multiplier
SELECT invenio_product_code, value_date, curr_mult, lot_mult, mult_factor FROM dbsystemuat.helper_var_mult_factor_view WHERE value_date IN (:vd1, :vd2)
SELECT invenio_product_code, value_date, curr_mult, lot_mult, mult_factor FROM opera.helper_var_mult_factor_view WHERE value_date IN (:vd1, :vd2)

expect.reason: every accounting product and date has a multiplier
RMC rows on UAT equal the legacy count
the UAT multiplier rows equal the legacy view for the two dates
